title: WASD Post
cue: screen looks in one pass: film, noir, comic, sketch, CRT
summary: The finished picture's look in one pass over the screen: color grade, vignette, grain, lens fringes, soft glow, ink lines, tilt-shift blur, pixels, scanlines, and sixteen named looks.
useWhen: The game is playable and its picture should get a mood or a style: a film grade, noir, horror, a faded photograph, a comic, a pencil sketch, an old television, night vision, a dream, or a miniature, the same in Web builds as on desktop, without touching the HUD.
avoidWhen: Only brightness, contrast, or saturation need a nudge, which wasd-look's values or the Environment give; ordinary bloom round lamps and screens, which is wasd-look's glow; outlines on the models themselves, which wasd-materials' toon draws; or blur by distance, which no Web build gives.
